Hi Ellen / procurement team,

Thanks again for the quick review on the DPA redlines. Attached is our clean DPA (v3) that incorporates the limited transfer clause you requested and the subprocessors appendix with the ISO references. Before we send an e-sign envelope, two quick asks to make sure the execution goes through without extra loopbacks: 

1) Signatory validation: please confirm who will countersign on Acme's side (name, title, and email). We need to make sure the person has authority per your procurement policy so DocuSign routing can be set correctly.

2) Countersign order: do you prefer simultaneous signing (all signers receive at once) or sequential (Acme -> Redwood countersign)? If you need countersign after an internal legal stamp, let us know the internal order.

3) Preferred e-sign tool: we plan to use DocuSign; if you must use AdobeSign we can flip the envelope but it will add ~1 business day.

I’m copying Laura (legal ops) and Karthik (platform ops) so we can stage the envelope and pre-fill the signatory matrix. If you’re good with the attached, reply with the signer name and preferred order and we’ll kick off the envelope today.

Thanks,
Marcus
